answers.2_slow_app_first_3: 1) response-time breakdown to see where time goes (API vs DB vs external call), 2) resource usage (CPU, memory, DB connection pool), 3) what changed recently (deploy/config/data) plus error and retry logs
answers.3_econnrefused: The app tried to reach a Postgres server on the local machine at port 5432 and nothing answered there - the database service is down or on another port.
answers.4_symptom_vs_root_cause: Symptom is what you observe (page is slow); root cause is the deeper reason it could go wrong (N+1 query). Fixing the symptom treats the effect; fixing the root cause stops the class of bug recurring.
answers.5_works_locally_not_prod: 1) environment difference - config/env vars, dependency versions, OS behavior; 2) production data or concurrency difference that triggers a code path local runs never exercise.
answers.6_read_error_vs_reproduce: Read the error message carefully first - it names the component and location of failure, the cheapest evidence for a specific hypothesis; reproduction comes after as verification.
answers.7_2am_service_down_first: Check if anything was deployed recently - the most common cause of sudden production downtime and non-destructive; restarting first can destroy in-memory evidence needed for root cause.
answers.8_it_worked_yesterday: What changed since then? (deploy, config, dependency, data)
